mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info WHERE insert_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info WHERE category_sn = 0
SELECT sn AS sn, article_title AS title, read_num AS readNum, review_num AS reviewNum, praise_num AS praiseNum FROM article_info ORDER BY read_num DESC, sn DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(req_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_addr) AS uv FROM log_info WHERE DATE(req_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(req_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(req_time) ORDER BY DATE(req_time) ASC

SELECT ip_addr AS ipAddr, country AS country, province AS province, city AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM log_info WHERE DATE(req_time) = CURDATE() AND ip_addr IS NOT NULL AND ip_addr != '' GROUP BY ip_addr, country, province, city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_info WHERE DATE(req_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip_addr) FROM log_info WHERE DATE(req_time) = CURDATE() AND ip_addr IS NOT NULL AND ip_addr != ''
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip_addr) FROM log_info WHERE ip_addr IS NOT NULL AND ip_addr != ''
